# openai_workload_identity_federation_rules (Data Source)

List workload identity federation rules, following pagination. Returns typed summaries and the raw response. Use the individual data source for full structured configuration.

Authentication: Set the admin_api_key provider attribute or OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY environment variable for the admin API audience.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openai_workload_identity_federation_rules" "example" {
  workload_identity_provider_id = "workload_identity_provider_123"
}
```
